Particle Filter Result Class

yuima.particleFilter-class.Rd

The yuima.particleFilter class contains filtering summaries, diagnostics, and optionally particle clouds and ancestry information. Its show and summary methods follow the presentation used by yuima.kalmanBucyFilter objects.

Slots

model

The fitted yuima.state_space_model.

data

The yuima.data object used by the filter.

mean

A time-series object of filtered state means.

vcov

A state-by-state-by-time array of filtered covariance matrices.

time

Observation times represented in the summaries.

particles

Stored filtering particle clouds, or an empty array.

weights

Weights corresponding to particles, or an empty matrix.

paths

Euler-Maruyama particle states when requested, or an empty array.

ancestors

One-based parent indices at observation times, or an empty matrix.

ess

Effective sample size at each observation time.

branched

Logical branching indicator at each observation time.

intervals

Weighted central particle intervals.

interval.levels

Levels represented by intervals.

logLik

Sum of sequential log normalizing constants.

logLik.increment

Log normalizing increment at each time.

call

The matched filtering call.

settings

Particle count, storage mode, and algorithm settings.

Methods

show

Displays filtered means and covariance matrices.

summary

Displays model, time-series, storage, and diagnostic metadata.

mean

Returns the filtered mean time series.

vcov

Returns the filtered covariance array.

plot

Draws filtered means using the Kalman-Bucy filter plot style, with optional stored particle intervals and true state values.

See also

particleFilter, plot, kalmanBucyFilter
